marks.name: Benllech Bay
marks.description: Published SeaAngler fishing mark at Benllech Bay. The publication describes fishing close in and advises care around the higher ledges.
tips: SeaAngler reports that many fish can be taken close in.
SeaAngler advises particular care from the higher ledges.
marks.access: SeaAngler directions approach Benllech from Menai Bridge via the A5025.

source.reference: Benllech Bay Sea Fishing Mark, published 17 June 2021
source.location_reference: British Beaches, Benllech Beach, approximate beach midpoint

marks.name: Cemlyn Beach
marks.description: SeaAngler published Cemlyn Beach as an easily accessible Anglesey mark, reporting codling, whiting and pouting and noting that the rocks at the end of the beach can also be worth trying.
tips: SeaAngler reported fish between approximately 30 and 100 yards out.
SeaAngler reported that evening was the better time in that report.
The rocks at the end of the beach were reported as worth trying during the day.
marks.access: SeaAngler described Cemlyn Beach as an easily accessible mark. Visit Anglesey identifies two car parks at either end of Cemlyn Bay.

source.reference: UK Sea Fishing Catch Reports 5.1.10, Anglesey section
source.location_reference: British Beaches, Cemlyn Beach, approximate beach midpoint
source.access_reference: Visit Anglesey, Countryside and coast at Cemlyn

marks.name: Garth Pier
marks.description: SeaAngler published Garth Pier as a sea-fishing venue, reporting bass to double figures along with cod, pollack, wrasse, mackerel and dogfish. The pier's current official visitor information confirms that fishing is currently permitted with a fishing pass.
marks.access: Current official Garth Pier information lists a fishing pass at £3 for a day or £10 annually. Current opening times are published by the pier and should be checked before travelling.

source.reference: Book This Pier for Just a Quid, published 9 September 2009
source.location_reference: Garth Pier coordinates independently checked against published geographic sources

marks.name: Calshot
marks.description: SeaAngler published Calshot as a shallow sea-fishing venue at the mouth of Southampton Water.
tips: SeaAngler reports the venue generally fishes during the last three hours of the flood and first couple of hours of the ebb.
marks.access: SeaAngler reports several pay-and-display car parks and some free parking near the access point close to the best fishing at the eastern end of the venue. Current local access conditions should be checked before travelling.

source.reference: Calshot Sea Fishing Mark, published 18 May 2021
source.location_reference: British Beaches, Calshot Beach, approximate beach midpoint
source.current_location_reference: Hampshire County Council Calshot visitor information

marks.name: Sandwich Bay
marks.description: SeaAngler published Sandwich Bay as a sea-fishing mark and identifies the 10th green near the slipway as a popular mark.
tips: SeaAngler reports fishing from low water up to high water can produce catches.
SeaAngler reports coloured water, especially after a south-westerly blow, can be productive.
marks.access: SeaAngler describes access via a right of way at The Chequers public house or along the sea wall from Deal. Current access conditions should be checked before travelling.

source.reference: Sandwich Bay Sea Fishing Mark, published 18 June 2021
source.location_reference: British Beaches, Sandwich Bay, approximate beach midpoint

marks.name: Blue Anchor
marks.description: SeaAngler published Blue Anchor as a group of shore marks covering the wall beside the road, the beach in front of the chalets and rocky reefs.
tips: SeaAngler reports the wall and beach fish best on tides over five metres, with larger tides more productive.
SeaAngler warns that the tide retreats a long distance at low water and that mud and quicksand are present.
marks.access: SeaAngler reports parking along the seafront and access to the wall, beach and reefs. The publication warns that anglers fishing the reefs should leave well before high water.

source.reference: Blue Anchor Sea Fishing Marks, published 16 June 2021
source.location_reference: British Beaches, Blue Anchor Beach, approximate beach midpoint
